description: The brief is fully specified and needs no research. Writing and finishing is right; reaching for a search action is over-eagerness with a full toolbelt. This agent's prompt mandates storing its output via payloadChangeRequest, so under the implicit protocol — where a payload write is its own turn — the write is the prompt-correct first decision and is accepted alongside completion. The loop itself treats a payload-only envelope as completion (LoopAgentType auto-sets taskComplete), so the branch matches runtime in both arms.

conversationMessages.content: Write the announcement from the brief in the payload. Everything you need is there.
